selection.decision_rule: Qualitative comparison of official-area gaps, native minimum cohorts, under-5/10/20 cohorts, inherited dependence, debt significance, source/study readiness and headroom; no arbitrary aggregate score.
selection.rationale: Civil Service has the strongest immediately actionable competency-level deficiency: its native bank has the lowest minimum cohort among broad general-ability candidates, many concepts remain under 10/20 questions, and current CSC-specific General Information, Verbal, Analytical, Numerical and Clerical scope can be expanded from existing authoritative/study chains. Inherited runtime content does not cure native thinness. CE has only three broad concepts but high per-concept cohorts and needs taxonomy granularity first; REE has a real mathematics/allied concentration but a narrower recent gap.

losing_board_deferrals.cpa: RESIDUAL_DEBT_NOT_CONTENT_GAP: six depth UNKNOWN legal/evidence records; current six-area source/study chain is strong and coverage debt is zero.
losing_board_deferrals.nursing: LOWER_ACTIONABLE_DEFICIENCY: NP I–V pools are balanced with zero depth debt; ten UNKNOWN rows remain shared-science boundaries and safety cost is high.
losing_board_deferrals.criminologist: RECENTLY_EXPANDED: six-area pool is broad; two coverage UNKNOWNs are evidence-boundary rows.
losing_board_deferrals.civil-engineering: NEEDS_TAXONOMY_WORK_FIRST: three official areas have large pools and strong sources, but concept granularity is too coarse for a large wave.
losing_board_deferrals.mechanical-engineering: RECENTLY_EXPANDED: 14 concepts/eight competency groups have usable support; remaining unevenness is lower than CSE cohorts.
losing_board_deferrals.registered-electrical-engineering: LOWER_ACTIONABLE_DEFICIENCY: professional pool is large/recent; mathematics/allied gaps need a narrower technical source pass.
losing_board_deferrals.architecture: NEEDS_TAXONOMY_WORK_FIRST: four broad concepts mask subcompetencies; current three-area pool needs granularity first.
losing_board_deferrals.psychometrician: RECENTLY_EXPANDED: four official areas have substantial cohorts/current sources; assessment concentration is monitoring debt.
